import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static int n, m, s, t, p, c, d;
    static int[] x = new int[505], y = new int[505];
    static int mxf, mnc;
    static int ee = 1;
    static int[] h = new int[5000005], nex = new int[10000010], to = new int[10000010], val = new int[10000010], cost = new int[10000010];
    static int[] dis = new int[5000005], pre = new int[5000005], last = new int[5000005], flow = new int[5000005];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[5000005];

    static void addedge(int x, int y, int z, int c) {
        nex[++ee] = h[x];
        to[ee] = y;
        val[ee] = z;
        cost[ee] = c;
        h[x] = ee;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        vis[s] = true;
        dis[s] = 0;
        flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        pre[t] = -1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            vis[x] = false;
            for (int i = h[x]; i != 0; i = nex[i]) {
                if (val[i] > 0 && dis[to[i]] > dis[x] + cost[i]) {
                    dis[to[i]] = dis[x] + cost[i];
                    pre[to[i]] = x;
                    last[to[i]] = i;
                    flow[to[i]] = Math.min(flow[x], val[i]);
                    if (!vis[to[i]]) {
                        vis[to[i]] = true;
                        q.offer(to[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[t] != -1;
    }

    static void mcmf() {
        mxf = 0;
        mnc = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int now = t;
            mxf += flow[t];
            mnc += flow[t] * dis[t];
            while (now != s) {
                val[last[now]] -= flow[t];
                val[last[now] ^ 1] += flow[t];
                now = pre[now];
            }
        }
    }

    static int zh(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        s = 0;
        t = n * 99 + 1;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            int xVal = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            x[i] = xVal;
            addedge(s, zh(0, xVal), 1, 0);
            addedge(zh(0, xVal), s, 0, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            x[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            y[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            // Connect layer i to i+1 for node 1
            addedge(zh(i, 1), zh(i + 1, 1), INF, 0);
            addedge(zh(i + 1, 1), zh(i, 1), 0, 0);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                // Connect layer i to i+1 for node j with capacity INF and cost c
                addedge(zh(i, j), zh(i + 1, j), INF, c);
                addedge(zh(i + 1, j), zh(i, j), 0, -c);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= p; k++) {
                    int cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c;
                    int fromX = x[j];
                    int toY = y[j];
                    // Edge from x[j] to y[j]
                    addedge(zh(i, fromX), zh(i + 1, toY), 1, cst);
                    addedge(zh(i + 1, toY), zh(i, fromX), 0, -cst);
                    // Edge from y[j] to x[j]
                    addedge(zh(i, toY), zh(i + 1, fromX), 1, cst);
                    addedge(zh(i + 1, fromX), zh(i, toY), 0, -cst);
                }
            }
        }

        mcmf();
        System.out.println(mnc);
    }
}
